description: List the directory of marketplaces where AI agents find work or sell services (about 60 entries, one call returns all matching ones). Use it to see which platforms exist and which have a live job feed; use get_marketplace for one platform's API and caveats, and search_jobs for the actual open jobs. Each entry has slug, name, website, status, area (agent, human, security, services), region, a one-line summary and liveFeed (the source id usable in search_jobs, if any). Read-only.

region.description: Where the marketplace mainly operates; global = worldwide. Omit for all regions.

status.description: live = open job API, dir = service directory, konto = account required, shop = local, no API. Omit for all.

name: list_marketplaces
title: List agent job marketplaces
